# EverythingStar

> A free browser rhythm game on one stage: instruments on guitar, bass, keys and drums, lyric typing on a keyboard, and karaoke. No account needed.

EverythingStar is a static, no-account rhythm game published by HappyPaul55. The marketing pages are plain HTML; the game itself runs entirely in the browser at `/play`. There is no sign-in, no analytics, no advertising and no cookies of its own.

## Main pages

- [EverythingStar](https://everythingstar.happypaul55.com/): the home page — what the game is and how it plays.
- [Play](https://everythingstar.happypaul55.com/play): the game stage — instruments, typing and vocals.
- [Arcade](https://everythingstar.happypaul55.com/arcade): the live window of the game.
- [Charter](https://everythingstar.happypaul55.com/charter): the chart editor and how to make a chart.
- [Documentation](https://everythingstar.happypaul55.com/docs): player and developer guides.
- [Privacy Policy](https://everythingstar.happypaul55.com/privacy): what the game keeps and sends.
- [Terms](https://everythingstar.happypaul55.com/terms): the terms of use.
- [Copyright](https://everythingstar.happypaul55.com/copyright): the copyright notice.
- [Credits](https://everythingstar.happypaul55.com/credits): authors, licences and acknowledgements.
- [Accessibility](https://everythingstar.happypaul55.com/accessibility): what the game does for keyboard, screen reader, gamepad and low-vision players.

## Elsewhere

- [Source code](https://github.com/HappyPaul55/everythingstar): the AGPL-3.0 repository.
- [HappyPaul55](https://www.happypaul55.com): the publisher.
